description: Application publication settings. All paths resolve relative to this file; required settings have no hardcoded fallbacks.

settings.persistenceConfig: Configuration file supplying the storage root, limits, and supported media types.
settings.visitorOrigin: Origin used to construct visitor URLs. Does not imply that a server is running.
settings.legacySourceRoot: Directory containing retained Markdown and MDX sources for explicit ingestion.
settings.legacyPublicRoot: Directory used to resolve legacy public asset paths during ingestion.
settings.preparedRoot: Directory containing reusable manifests and prepared inputs with stable record identities.
